status_policy: Open means no compiled new statement/passage correspondence is claimed. Historical receipts remain historical; candidates are not accepted mappings.

passages.title: Signed indices, maxima and the two pseudometrics
inference_obligations: Finite index type has a zero point and two distinct signed slots for each of p>=1 coordinates; its cardinality is 2*p+1.
Evaluate X_t=t dot W and Y_t=t dot Z; prove zero and both pointwise maximum identities.
Define d1=delta*1_{s!=t} on original indices, and d2 from the Gaussian second moment; prove finite nonnegative symmetric triangle properties.
scope_constraints: No quotienting of signed-coordinate labels is permitted for d1.

passages.title: Bernstein mixed tails for actual bounded-sum contrasts
inference_obligations: Derive measurability, integrability, centering and independence of every contrast from the bounded-sum assumptions.
Prove the almost-sure contrast envelope 2*delta and variance sum equal to the matching Gaussian contrast variance.
Apply scalar Bernstein MGF to each sign and optimize with explicit universal constants; handle s=t and zero contrast variance.
scope_constraints: The mixed-tail hypothesis is an output, not an admissible extra premise of C.2.
A Bernstein theorem supplied with an assumed MGF or assumed variance identity does not by itself close this passage.
audited_dependency_candidates: Scalar Bernstein MGF implementation and Chernoff optimization in the archive; exact expanded type and new instantiation pending.

passages.title: Admissible-subset functional and metric scaling
inference_obligations: Match nonempty finite subsets and indexed slots, including the singleton first level.
Identify the weights 2^k and sqrt(2)^k with the printed exponents.
Prove finite metric costs and justify real values before metric homogeneity and tail-scale factors are used.
scope_constraints: The printed later subsets must be nonempty so that distance to a net is defined; the library makes this convention explicit.

passages.title: Dirksen expectation at zero and the variance-one extra term
inference_obligations: Supply HasMixedTail from C2.2 and integrable increments, then instantiate Dirksen at the zero index.
Use C2.1 to identify the left-hand maximum and C2.3 for both scaled functionals.
For every signed coordinate use Cauchy--Schwarz and unit marginal variance to show E|X_t|<=1; the zero slot contributes zero.
scope_constraints: Do not assume the desired maximum comparison or a bound on E||W||infinity as an input.

passages.title: Singleton-then-full discrete nets and logarithmic cost
inference_obligations: Witness the smallest cutoff with 2^(2^k)>=2*p+1 and prove admissibility at level zero.
Sum the finite dyadic approximation errors and bound the cutoff by log(2*p+1).
Prove the final comparison log(2*p+1)<=C*log(e*p), including p=1.
scope_constraints: p>=1 implies |T|>=3 and the printed cutoff is positive, so T_0 remains a singleton.

passages.title: Concrete Gaussian canonical geometry and majorizing measures
inference_obligations: Construct a covariance factor (or prove a supported representation) from positive semidefiniteness of Cov(W), allowing singularity.
Match Gaussian contrast second moments with squared Euclidean distances for the signed coefficient vectors.
Identify the one-sided signed-and-zero Gaussian maximum with ||Z||infinity and apply the actual audited majorizing-measure theorem.
If quotienting is used, prove surjectivity, zero-contrast almost-sure equality and preservation of the functional and maximum.
scope_constraints: The Gaussian comparison/lower chaining inequality cannot be an assumed premise of the paper theorem.
Exact positive and negative correlations may identify canonical points but must not identify the original discrete indices.

passages.title: Assemble and absorb the constant uniformly in positive dimension
inference_obligations: Combine both chaining bounds with the extra term <=2.
Prove g_Sigma>=E|Z_1|=sqrt(2/pi)>0 from a unit Gaussian marginal.
Choose the final universal constant before n,p,delta,the summands and covariance; include p=1 explicitly.
scope_constraints: No asymptotic dimension assumption, nonsingularity assumption or small-envelope assumption is present in Lemma C.2.
